_comment: Partner record for the Ralph Lauren × Tour de France microsite. Rules: brand/rl/COBRAND-RULES.md.

partner.name: Tour de France
partner.programme: Ralph Lauren × Tour de France capsule collection launch for the 2027 Tour (wholesale)

source.notes: Quick capture of the partner homepage at 1440px. Brand yellow #ffff00 (rgb 255,255,0) on near-black grounds (#191919); partner typefaces Galibier and Open Sans (not used: COBRAND-RULES § 3 forbids partner typefaces). Logo files taken from letour.fr (/img/global/logo@2x.png and logo-reversed@2x.png, 160×124 PNG); ask A.S.O. for the approved SVG lockup before building.

colors._notes: Tour de France yellow #ffff00 reaches only 1.07:1 on white, so the accent is a deepened 'maillot gold' that keeps the yellow hue. Pure yellow is used only over darkened photography (accentOnImage). One hue in total (yellow), in three strengths.
